items.title: Joseph 'One Eyed Babe' Phillips Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: So Boyd told me that the last he saw Punch in the 11th East Band up north somewhere.

ctx.x: Now, that's what the people used to be crazy about. The people used to cry out there. But Joe Oliver. He eat us on a condom blue. Oh. Oh, yes. This man, Buddy Petit and Punch. Oh, I'm treated at a good... I have a love now somewhere.

No, Punch is here. He's staying at the Page Hotel. Oh, no. That's right. Oh. Punch is here? Yeah. I almost got arrested with another night. I had a headache so I didn't play. Oh. The judge didn't like it. We were mixing it up, you know. Yeah, I know they don't like it.

I almost got arrested with another night. They just don't like it. And it ain't no use of trying to put it over. They don't like it. And it's been going on before you, you, me or him was born. That mix. And they ain't gonna never break it up. Oh, no. Well, I mean, you just gotta sit in. They ain't gonna be friends. They ain't gonna never break that mess up, no, huh? I have a cousin, she might pass here. She's white as you, and no more as my cousin. She's kind of me. Yeah. That's right. And that daddy died. Up…
